name: NusaX-Senti: Multilingual Sentiment Analysis Benchmark for Indonesian Local Languages
description: NusaX-Senti is a high-quality multi-parallel sentiment analysis benchmark spanning 10 Indonesian local languages (Acehnese, Balinese, Banjarese, Buginese, Madurese, Minangkabau, Javanese, Ngaju, Sundanese, Toba Batak) along with Indonesian and English (12 languages total). It contains exactly 1,000 parallel sentences per language (12,000 sentences total) translated and verified by professional native-speaker linguists into positive, neutral, and negative labels. Standard evaluation splits provide 500 train, 100 validation, and 400 test sentences per language (Train: 6,000, Validation: 1,200, Test: 4,800).
